the assertion `[row["lint_total"] for row in rows] == [sum(row["lint"].values()) for row in rows]` compares the report's own output to itself, and lint_total is built as the sum of lint values (harmonize.py:599, harmonize.py:628), so it holds whatever the attribution does and cannot catch the regression it appears to guard.

baseline_suite and after_suite record their command as the placeholder `<13 gate files>` rather than the literal command that ran, so the recorded gate cannot be re-run as written; the file list survives only in the gate-base.log and gate-after.log headers.
